Travelling has its perks. In fact, it is one of the best ways to make friends, experience global life, and bring back memorable videos and photos. Nothing tops that, except going to space. 

Crossing borders has its charms, which includes, whether you realize it or not, subjecting yourself to individual countries and their legal or cultural quirks, crime being one of them. 

And among some of the more harrowing experiences, is the kidnapping for ransom.
#block#graphic://content/mail/ransom1.png#block#
While armed robbery is not something to shrug off, the ordeal normally lasts no more than the robber is willing to hang around before undue attention or the police arrives. A kidnapping, however, is in the interest of the criminal to last as long as possible, to eke out greater financial demands upon the family whose member is now in the hands of rough uncultured men across the ocean. 

At times like this, reporters, police and even politicians have their limits in moving the minds of the kidnappers. What they want is money, and while governments are all about not giving in to terrorists, the families have more practical matters to worry, such as the life of their loved ones. 

This is where insurance will come in. The K&R insurance, or Kidnap and Ransom insurance, are backed by most insurance companies which become a valuable tool in the hands of families negotiating with the kidnappers. 

Normally these premiums are rather high, and meant for important members of companies or governments. But if you think you are travelling into dangerous areas and are of an asset yourself, do take a look at the packages these companies offer. Remember, money can always be earned back, but lives are a one-way ticket.

[MAIL_BOLD]Six Ways Globalization Can Help You Find Love[]

The world is our oyster. It is real, connected, and more than ever before we can get anywhere at a fraction of the cost during our grandparents’ time. It is a great period to fall in love. 

Here are the 6 ways we think you can use globalization to your advantage.
#block#graphic://content/mail/sparkles1.png#block#
[MAIL_BOLD]1. Data Connection[]
And should the digital cupid ever strike gold, and you are on cloud nine, be assured that should you ever need to go back to your homeland and manage a long distance relationship, it is a far cry from the long months of waiting for that snail mail between lovers. Keep in touch in all sorts of ways, calls, messages, videos, and even the occasional surprise delivery from online shopping to keep the flames stoking. 
#block#graphic://content/mail/sparkles2.png#block#
[MAIL_BOLD]2. Niche Interest[]
With demographics no longer an issue, finding love is not based on race, language, gender or even location. It is down to background, or rather, the very interesting niche interests you both have. Find common ground using the power of the interwebs, where broadband equalizes your chances to meet someone who is as obsessed with NyanCat as you are.
#block#graphic://content/mail/sparkles3.png#block#
[MAIL_BOLD]3. Digital Booking[]
Now that you have landed, need a place to stay? Sure, you can always bunk with your potential partner, but if circumstances, or traditional parents, are in the way, then use any of the current means of online booking of lodging at exactly your needs, including, when your other half decides to pop by for an intimate visit. 
#block#graphic://content/mail/sparkles4.png#block#
[MAIL_BOLD]4. Language Bridge[]
Speak different languages? No problem. With a growing body of translation apps on your devices, say farewell to moments that get lost in translation. Learning a new language, or finding digital assistance with current conversations, is only a touchscreen swipe away. Let not conversational barriers stop you from falling in globalized love.
#block#graphic://content/mail/sparkles5.png#block#
[MAIL_BOLD]5. Cheap Flights[]
All kinds of digital services can help you keep track of the best flights to meet your better half, including special promos, mileage bonuses, and even finding the most obscure travel routes known to the industry. No place is too remote to find your true love.
#block#graphic://content/mail/sparkles6.png#block#
[MAIL_BOLD]6. Social Media[]
Let the internet be your cupid. Whether social platforms, blogs, dating sites or just plain fan groups, there are plenty of spaces to interact and make the hot connection.

From,
#block#graphic://left=0.4=content/mail/text/spark-footer.png#block#align://center/

[MAIL_BOLD]Students Unable To Feed Themselves[]

The developed nations spend nights brooding over the issues of military defense, public health, and ailing economies. But there is a greater danger at large here, and more dangerous because it is ignored for being relatively harmless. It is the student debt. 

Each year, hundreds of graduates leave their campuses, entering the workforce with certifications. Their earnings are nominal at best, keeping them fed and clothed with a place to stay. Life is at a minimal, and savings paltry, or nonexistent. 

That is, unless they are paying back their education debt. 
#block#graphic://content/mail/student-debt1.png#block#
The growing ranks of middle income families spark more doom than cheer. While human rights supporters sing praises for improvements in raising prosperity of the poor and homeless, including the educating of children to break out of the poverty cycle, they do not consider the increased commitments of entering a middle income lifestyle.

Student debts are by far the lowest interest rate available in banks, but for young people barely making basic wage, it is a punishing uphill battle of mathematics. With parents saddled in their own student debt and mortgage, progressive generations of teenagers are beginning to feel the effects of taking a loan to attain their dream jobs through tertiary education. A more alarming trend is the rise of dropouts, not because of failing grades, but from failing finances.

We are merely moving the oppressive cycle from poverty to student debt, leaving families vulnerable to disruption in jobs, market forces and currency injuries. Parents are moving their children into homeschool initiatives, while others follow the age-old tradition of apprenticeship. Slowly and surely, people are taking matters into their own hands of educating their young and not becoming enslaved to the debt engine. The collapse of the economy from property debt has only been too clear a warning sign for us all.

Thanks for subscribing to The Write Thing
es:
graphic://center=0.7=content/mail/text/writething.png#block#
[MAIL_BOLD]Estudiantes Incapaces De Alimentarse[]

Las naciones desarrolladas pasan las noches cavilando sobre los temas de defensa militar, salud publica y economias enfermas. Pero aqui acecha un peligro mayor, y mas peligroso porque se ignora por parecer relativamente inofensivo. Es la deuda estudiantil.

Cada ano, cientos de graduados dejan sus campus y entran al mundo laboral con titulos. Sus ingresos son nominales en el mejor de los casos, apenas para comer, vestirse y tener donde vivir. La vida esta al minimo y los ahorros son escasos o inexistentes.

Es decir, a menos que esten pagando su deuda educativa.
#block#graphic://content/mail/student-debt1.png#block#
El creciente numero de familias de ingresos medios genera mas pesimismo que alegria. Mientras los defensores de los derechos humanos cantan alabanzas por las mejoras en la prosperidad de los pobres y desamparados, incluida la educacion de los ninos para romper el ciclo de la pobreza, no consideran los mayores compromisos de adoptar un estilo de vida de ingresos medios.

Las deudas estudiantiles tienen, de lejos, la tasa de interes mas baja disponible en los bancos, pero para los jovenes que apenas ganan el salario basico, es una dura batalla cuesta arriba de matematicas. Con los padres cargados con su propia deuda estudiantil e hipoteca, generaciones progresivas de adolescentes empiezan a sentir los efectos de pedir un prestamo para alcanzar sus trabajos sonados mediante la educacion superior. Una tendencia mas alarmante es el aumento de los desertores, no por malas calificaciones, sino por malas finanzas.

Solo estamos trasladando el ciclo opresivo de la pobreza a la deuda estudiantil, dejando a las familias vulnerables a las interrupciones en el empleo, las fuerzas del mercado y los golpes de la moneda. Los padres estan pasando a sus hijos a iniciativas de educacion en casa, mientras otros siguen la antigua tradicion del aprendizaje. Lenta y seguramente, la gente toma el asunto en sus propias manos de educar a sus jovenes y no volverse esclavos del motor de la deuda. El colapso de la economia por la deuda inmobiliaria ha sido una senal de advertencia demasiado clara para todos nosotros.

Gracias por suscribirte a The Write Thing

en: What Totem Animal Spirit Are You?

What Totem Animal Spirit
Are You?

As cities begin to take over our
world, and our natural land disap-
pear, we begin to question the
wisdom of forgetting our roots, along
with the ancient traditions that can
teach us a thing or two.

One of the most beloved, and tragic,
of cultural loss, are the Native Ameri-
cans. They welcomed the westerners
with open arms, and received bullets,
disease and loss of property. Their
culture collapsed under the hail of
gunfire and imperialism, and now
they are surviving at the edges of
modern society, pushed aside by
progress and development.
es:
Mientras las ciudades empiezan a dominar
nuestro mundo y nuestra tierra natural desapa-
rece, empezamos a cuestionar la
sabiduria de olvidar nuestras raices, junto
con las tradiciones antiguas que pueden
ensenarnos una que otra cosa.

Una de las perdidas culturales mas
queridas, y tragicas, son los nativos
americanos. Recibieron a los occidentales
con los brazos abiertos, y recibieron balas,
enfermedad y perdida de sus bienes. Su
cultura se derrumbo bajo la lluvia de
balas y el imperialismo, y ahora
sobreviven en los margenes de la
sociedad moderna, apartados por el
progreso y el desarrollo.

en:
The Canadians are at least trying to
honor these people, and the Austra-
lians painfully scaling back their preju-
dice. Americans are a long way to go,
but, we are at least starting to accept
their identity, their way of life, and
most interestingly, some of their phi-
losophy. 

One of the most enigmatic facets of
their tribal society is the association
of totem animal spirits to each
member of their large family. Traits
and characteristics of the animal are
believed to infuse into the connected
person, reflected in both physical and
spiritual qualities. 

Have a look through these modern
animals, and see if you can spot your
totem animal spirits in your personal
reflection.
es:
Los canadienses al menos intentan
honrar a esta gente, y los austra-
lianos reducen con dolor sus prejui-
cios. A los estadounidenses les falta
mucho, pero al menos empezamos a aceptar
su identidad, su forma de vida y,
lo mas interesante, parte de su filo-
sofia.

Una de las facetas mas enigmaticas de
su sociedad tribal es la asociacion
de los espiritus animales totemicos con cada
miembro de su gran familia. Se cree
que los rasgos y caracteristicas del animal
se infunden en la persona conectada,
reflejados tanto en cualidades fisicas como
espirituales.

Echa un vistazo a estos animales
modernos, y ve si puedes encontrar tu
espiritu animal totemico en tu reflejo
personal.
